tools.description: Get the exact input-aware execution price for an API, free and without a key. Nothing is charged or executed. `sku_id` and `input` identify the proposed execution; pricing resolves exactly as it does for execution, and input validation can return invalid_input without a charge. Returns maxCostUsd (the ceiling reserved), minCostUsd (the likely charge), and the base/per-item breakdown explaining why they differ. These are USD amounts for this one call, not per-1,000-request catalog comparison rates.

tools.description: Execute an API by API slug with a normalized input payload. Every input schema is strict: unknown fields are rejected, not ignored, and field names can differ between related APIs. Inputs must conform to the endpoint's schema, not its description. Published latency p50/p95/p99 and sample counts describe observed successful requests; p99 is an observation, not a maximum or a client timeout guarantee. Requires a valid AnyAPI key as a Bearer token. Charges the USD wallet. Some failed wallet-funded requests incur processing charges passed through at cost, with no markup; the error message shows the amount charged. Results can be large. `fields` keeps selected keys, `max_items` caps returned rows, and `summary` returns an outline; these controls reduce response size without changing the charge.

tools.description: Search APIs by meaning and keyword across name, slug, and description, returning matches with their descriptions but without schemas, ranked most relevant first. At least one of `query`, `category`, or `platform` is required, in any combination; `category` or `platform` without `query` enumerates that scope. `limit` caps matches (default 25, maximum 50). Each result carries a `relevance` score in (0,1] relative to the top match; a relevance floor drops weak matches, so `total` counts relevant matches before the limit. `ranking` identifies meaning-based ('semantic') or substring ('keyword') matching. Entries with heavy:true produce large API responses. Search results omit input schemas; API inputs require the endpoint's strict schema, whose field names can differ between related APIs.

category.description: optional category slug to narrow the search

context.description: Brief purpose of this tool call within the requested task, used for analytics and user-intent tracking.

limit.description: optional cap on matches returned (default 25, maximum 50)

platform.description: optional API slug prefix to narrow the search

query.description: free-text search over API name, slug, and description; optional when category or platform is given

tools.name: search_apis

relevance.description: relative relevance in (0,1], 1.0 = the best match
